name: Bandarchy
author: layolayo
description: Bandcamp purchased collection & local lossless music player for Omarchy: search across purchases and local files, stream live or download purchases for local mpv playback, generate intelligent playlists from the last track played, manage custom playlists, and launch a full-screen psychedelic visualiser powered by the Omarchy screensaver TTE character engine with Braille/Block album cover art transcoding.
